lrn.title: Decisions & learning
lrn.sub: What the team decided on what the engine stopped or proposed, per rule and per person, and what that teaches. It only suggests: nothing changes by itself.
lrn.off: Learning is off. Every decision is still kept with its note; turn learning on in the card below to read them here and on open reviews.
lrn.cut: More decisions than the report reads: only the newest {n} are counted. Raise the most decisions in the card below.

kpi.letGoFoot: {pct} of the decisions: the engine's stop was let go
kpi.refusedFoot: Orders let go that came back at the door

sug.d: A rule decided at least {n} times that people let go (or kept) at least {pct} of the time. Change a rule only in Risk rules, if you agree.
sug.none: Nothing to suggest yet: no rule has enough decisions, people decide its reviews both ways, or too many of the orders let go came back at the door.
sug.relax: {rule}: people let {share} of {n} go, and those orders were mostly delivered. The rule may be too strict — consider making it a watch, or raising its limits.
sug.keep: {rule}: people kept {share} of {n}. The rule is doing its job.

rules.d: Each review or proposal counts once, with its last decision. "Let go, delivered" means the person was right to let it go.

people.d: Every decision counts, with each person's latest notes. Use it to coach, not to blame: a rule that fires wrongly makes everyone let go.

lrn.note: To change a rule, go to Orders › Risk rules. To see what the engine stopped, Reports › Stopped by the engine.

card.d: Whether the learning reads the team's decisions, how far back, and when it says something.
card.minDecisions: Fewest decisions on a rule before it says anything
card.minDecisionsHelp: 3 to 1,000. Keeps a few decisions from making a suggestion.
card.suggestPercent: Suggest when people decide one way this share (%) of the time

lrn.readOnly: Only someone allowed to change settings can change this.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this meanwhile. The card now shows theirs; change it again if needed.
err.network: No connection. Nothing was saved; try again.
err.other: Something went wrong. Nothing was saved; try again.
